title: WPA band: Petoni headquarters and the Tulane Club
summary: The big WPA band met at Petoni on Dumaine until drinking and check-cashing led authorities to move it to the Tulane Club.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Oh, I was asking some more about that WPA band, those groups during the Depression, what happened those years. Yeah. Who was the leader and how big a band they had?

Oh, we had a big band, yes. See, I'm standing up there. See, with that long tire, that's me standing up on that WPA band. Now, we used to play out there. And we used to go at Petoni there. That's why we had to meet there every morning.
Petoni on Dumain Street. That's why the prize fight ring used to be.

Well, that was us headquarters there. But I'll tell you what happened. That man used to get all them checks there for liquor and things. And the WPA band didn't want that. Uh-huh. The WPA people, you know. And they come to find out all them men there in one place like that. And them fellas had to begin to get drunk and everything. And cashing all their checks right there. Well, they didn't want that. Uh-huh. So they moved us to the Tulane. Uh-huh. See. Now, we had to go all over town then and in different places. And they moved. That's why we had to meet there at the Tulane after that.
On Padilla Street. The Tulane Club.

Oh, that's why we. Up near Roman. Up near Roman. That's right. Yes. So they moved them there. You see. Now, we had the best place out there. You won't see it, Petoni. Because nobody couldn't see nothing. And then besides that, you was in a nice place. And when you'd leave home, everybody was being near in the same cellman. You could walk there. But after the movie to Tulane, well, it was a whole lot of difficult there.
You said that some of the musicians drank, huh?
Oh, yeah. They drank. That's why they cut it out from out there. Because Petoni was getting all them checks. I guess they didn't want him to get all them checks.
